name: Monster Truck
requirements: Side-view pixel art facing right, about 30 to 70 px wide (our world: one art pixel is 1/16 unit). Prefer separate wheel sprites so a physics rig can be built, or a clean body plus wheel positions.
notes: Forged: monster_body.png 33x11 (Kenney suv_large cab with its wheels erased), monster_chassis.png 40x5 (axle bar + two struts), monster_wheel.png 15x15 (own code circle, tread lugs). Limits: The cab keeps a little leftover white from the SUV roof rack and the cut arches are a bit rough; the big wheel is cleaner than the body; wheel is a single frame (rotate in engine).
licence: own work (derivative of CC0 Kenney Pixel Vehicle Pack)

history.note: OGA monster truck CC0 results (monstertruck Body/Tire, hill-climb, monster-truck-1/-0) are vector/smooth (1000+ colours) or CC-BY; none pixel art. Forge: re-wheel Kenney suv_large/pickup.
